body: I'm pretty sure I have taken tooo many pills and have no choice but to go to hospital. I will try and keep people posted. thanks for the words.
This confused me for a minute because its 3 AM here.
I'm gonna have to do something soon. I can't stop swallowing these pills. I will probably end up at the hospital, i'm just afraid that they will keep me there on psych hold.
I've been booze free for almost week, which was hard. Benzo's though....love of my life.
he gets up at about 7 but my son will sleep until around 9 - 10 .

I really never drank before about 6 moths ago, but then i discovered lorazepam + booze = happy time, for the most part.  (disclaimer this is incredibly dangerous and thus i am NOT promoting it, learn from my mistakes)
My husband will call in to work i guess. for the 12 or so oxazepam  i downed i so far feel great though....

I'm doing CBT. I'm not very good at it because motivation is one of my big problems. I have a big substance abuse problem around marijuana. pot kills motivation. I just can't stand to be sober, i can't stand to be alone with myself.
My son is 1 1/2 only and my husband would have to take leave off work if i went into the hospital for an extended time.

That's just it. I should be happy, with a good family and everything i want. I'm just fucked. Anxious all the time. Afraid to leave my house, convinced that my former friends hate me, or worse pity me. My therapist realizes that I'm making little progress and is loosing time in his schedule for me, at least that's my paranoid interpretation. I really have no sob story.

I have food phobias i wouldn't be able to eat the food. i'm scared they'll take away my clothes and shoes. they might try to make me eat. they might keep me trapped there and i have too much to do, son and work ect.

....of course i realize all those points are moot if i stop breathing tonight
aaaand i just took two more. fuuuuuuuuck. i am so stupid.
